newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso falls to record low.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso falls to record low.

text.p: The Philippine peso fell in morning trading to equal its record low of 30 to dollar, and later dipped further to 30.05, traders said.
The peso hit 30 last month after the central bank was forced to allow a de facto devaluation.
Volume was 49 million after 90 minutes of trading.
Traders said the central bank still opted to keep out of the market by quoting wide bid and offer rates for the dollar at 27/30.15.
The market had expected the peso to test 30 again in the face of persistent volatility in the region's currencies.
At around 10.40 am (0240 gmt) the peso was trading at 30.10.
